rows.en: Huh!? The pool...?
Oh, come on, just come with me. That's an order!

Haaah~
This feeling of freedom really is nice. It's the best!

Well, if we keep doing this without permission...
and on top of that, you brought in a swimsuit
like that...
rows.notes: ageku sonna mizugi mochikonde: she brought her own swimsuit instead of the class one.

rows.en:
Oh my, \p,
you're more of a chicken than I thought. Hee hee.
I don't think this is about guts...
(Sheryl's bolder than I thought...)
(Now, where should I take Sheryl-san today...)

\p-chan!
Come on, let's go!
Huh!? Go where?

Hmm, if we keep doing this without permission...
and on top of that, you brought in a swimsuit
like that...

Oh my, \p-chan,
you're more of a chicken than I thought. Hee hee.
(Sheryl-san sure is bolder than you'd think...)

(So today I worked up the nerve to invite her
off campus, but...)

I'm leaving today's plans entirely up to you.
Make sure you don't disappoint me.
You're tough...
Come on, let's go!
Wow, it's got a nice kick, and it's delicious!

So this is the famous Nyan-Nyan. I've heard about it,
but this is my first time here.

So this is the Sky Gate...
Seeing it from the outside, it's really big. Amazing~

Phew...
So? What do you think of Island 1?

It's great. Everywhere is really interesting!
Where are we going next?

Huh? Next...?
Then how about we go to Island 3?
Hee hee, come on, the fun's just starting!
What, what, what? What is thiiis!
This is so fun! It's just like a fairyland!

The birds are singing, and the forest stretches
out so far.

Everywhere is so interesting!
Frontier really is a nice place.
Hearing you say that makes me kind of happy.

Back in the Galaxy fleet where I was born...
No, never mind.
rows.notes: 'Galaxy' = Sheryl's home fleet (Macross Galaxy fleet); written 'the Galaxy fleet' for clarity.

rows.en:
Come on, we're only getting started!
Show me lots more places!
Wha!? Seriously, no more...

(Phew, looks like I managed to satisfy her...
I'm worn out, but it was fun.)

(So today I worked up the nerve to invite her
off campus, but...)
Sheryl-san, you're tough...

Phew...
So? What do you think of Island 1?

Huh? Next...?
Then shall we go to Island 3?
Hearing you say that makes me kind of happy.

(Phew, looks like I managed to satisfy her...
I'm a little tired, but that was fun~)
(So, is today another date with Sheryl...?)

Sorry to keep you waiting, \p.
I'm looking forward to today too. I'm counting on you!
Ah, don't expect so much from me...
Hee hee, oh well. Let's hurry up and go!
Haah~ Today was fun too!

Glad to hear it.
Though I took you to the same places as last time...
...Maybe the place isn't what matters...
Hm? Sheryl?

Never mind.
Well then, thanks for today.
(What was Sheryl trying to say...?)
(Okay, another outing with Sheryl-san today!)

Sorry to keep you waiting, \p-chan.
I'm looking forward to today too. I'm counting on you!

I'm glad.
Though I did take you to the same places as last time...
Hm? Sheryl-san?
(What's up with Sheryl-san?)

(Today's my vacation on the artificial island
with Sheryl!)

Hi~, \p.
Did you manage to sleep last night?

Well, how rude. That face of yours says
"I slept like a log~."
rows.notes: She expected the player to be too excited to sleep.

rows.en: Well, yeah.

You'll never get another vacation with Sheryl,
you know. Be grateful.

Well, whatever.
Now, let's gooo!
Sheryl's taking a while...
Sorry to keep you waiting. Tired of waiting yet?
Geez, how long does it take to change...
(Whoa... the Galactic Fairy...)

Oh, would you stop giving me funny looks?
Though I doubt you can see anyone but me anyway.
No, nothing like that...
rows.notes: x3: also in nml_yuu_014 (both genders) answering Akimizu's 'Is something strange?'; wording fits both.

rows.en:
That's rude in its own way.
Well, whatever. We're on the artificial island,
after all. Let's have fun!
Wow, so this is the sea. It feels so good~!
Hee hee, the waves tickle. Hee hee hee.

Come on, \p,
you come over here too.
Why, you! Take thaaat!
Hee hee hee.
Phew, I'm tired~
What, already? How pathetic!
Geez, I'm no match for you...
But it was fun...
I wish every day could be like this...

No, never mind...
Today was fun. Thank you.
No, I had fun too.
(Sheryl seemed a little different from usual...)
